title: Full Stack Engineer
text:
About Brightwater Health
Brightwater Health builds the scheduling and records platform behind 300 community clinics. We are a small, remote-first engineering team that ships every day and keeps on-call quiet.
The role
As a Full Stack Engineer you will own services end to end: design reviews, the code, the dashboards and the pager. You will work closely with product and with the other engineers on the team.
What you will need
- 3+ years of hands-on experience with Elasticsearch
- 4+ years of hands-on experience with Terraform
- 5+ years of hands-on experience with TypeScript
- 2+ years of hands-on experience with Python
- several years of hands-on experience with CI/CD
- 3+ years of hands-on experience with Distributed Systems
- Clear written communication; we decide things in documents
Nice to have
- Exposure to Go
- Exposure to gRPC
Benefits
Competitive salary and equity, a learning budget, and four weeks of vacation that people actually take.
